Although the report generator describes the hila as normal (a likely false negative given the visual evidence and high classifier score for 'Mass'), Option C is the only choice that accurately reflects the visible bilateral pathology and distinguishes it from the unilateral or cavitary findings typical of lymphoma or tuberculosis. *(guided by t000002, t000008)*
